purpose: Make the native editor and development game client a synchronized local authoring pair so saved project-source changes can be pushed into the running client without rebuilding when only assets or authored world data changed.

editor.savePolicy: Saving writes authoritative project files first. Push only invalidates/reloads the running development client and is never the persistence authority.

permanence.authoritativeEdits: project source files saved by the editor
permanence.rule: Closing the editor/client never removes a successfully saved project-source edit. Rebuild is required only for executable Rust changes; asset/world saves remain on disk independently of the client process.
permanence.worldSaveRule: Editor Save writes the machine-local working world and then the source-controlled Core Dev authored mirror. Client live world reload consumes the source-controlled mirror.

handoff.purpose: Create one uploadable local-change ZIP relative to the user's captured project baseline so local editor-authored changes can be synchronized back into the Havenwild project chat.
handoff.rule: A development handoff is synchronization transport only. It never replaces the required cumulative overwrite patch for an assistant-completed pass.

developmentMap.finiteCoreDevWorldTarget: show all currently available/manifest-backed geography while development reveal is active

deferred: fixed Core Development Seed number + certification bookmarks/regression-seed authoring
client session position restore after executable rebuild
